- Channel age (when was the first video uploaded or channel created)

Do MULTIPLE searches per channel to get accurate data. Try:
- '[channel name] socialblade'
- '[channel name] youtube subscribers'
- '[channel name] youtube channel'

Be thorough. Real numbers only — don't fabricate. If you can't find exact data, say 'estimated' with your source.
